posts.title: ASKY tales
posts.description: ASKY is one of the more reliable airlines in West Africa. They however keep shifting their flight schedules quite frequently. During our last trip to Malabo they altered the schedule last minute and we had to fly all the way down to Addis to get back to Yaounde. During both our onward and return flights this time we had to fly via Lome. Travel to constituents is such a pain here in Africa at times

posts.title: Ebogo
posts.description: We finally made it to Ebogo this morning! Been on our list for a while now but for some reason it never materialized. About 55 kms from home with the last 7 kms through unpaved road - Getting there was super straight forward. Alexis our guide greeted us cheerfully and quickly got us into the Padauk pirogues. posts.title: Thirsty Snyder
posts.description: One of the perks of my job is to meet and work with so many interesting people. And with anything that awesome, it’s almost always short-lived. People move on once their assignment comes to an end and somebody else comes and fills their shoes. Snyder is leaving us this weekend and he will very much be missed! We have an unsaid practice in ST to host Thirsty Thursday’s . It’s a HUGE morale booster
